patch.summary: Bitbucket Cloud cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Bitbucket Cloud pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. 30-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Bitbucket Cloud plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

blocks.heading: Bitbucket Cloud cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Bitbucket Cloud against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise security and SSO (Free, Standard, Premium)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (log management, source control and repos, CI/CD and automation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Paid plans bill a 5-user floor even for 2-person teams. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

blocks.title: Bitbucket Cloud cost mistakes to avoid

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Paid plans bill a 5-user floor even for 2-person teams

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Ecosystem and Actions marketplace trail GitHub

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: SAML SSO often needs Atlassian Guard extra

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not observability or ITSM (use JSM separately)
